messages:
Maya Torres: Heads-up — ACME renewal next week and their usage spike last month exposed gaps in our onboarding prefill + streaming behavior. Can we create one short, customer-facing checklist (not internal runbook) they can follow to stabilize latency and reduce errors?
Liam Chen: +1. We should include quick wins: enable edge prefill for top 10 prompts, jitter prefill schedules, and a streaming fallback if batch fails.
Aisha Patel: agree. Also add three telemetry checkpoints so CS can validate success: prefill hit rate, median stream latency, and queue depth. Keep the metrics names simple for customers (e.g., "prefill_hit_pct", "stream_median_ms", "pending_requests_count").
Maya Torres: Good. Want this to be a short doc customers can run through during enablement calls. Draft structure idea: 1) quick checklist (5 items), 2) sample prefill config snippet, 3) golden signals to watch, 4) escalation/contacts.
Samir Rao: I can take the checklist. Will include renewal-risk note: if prefill_hit_pct < 60% + stream_median_ms > 800ms for 3 consecutive days, recommend increasing warm pool size or enabling dedicated capacity.
Liam Chen: Add a low-friction API example customers can copy for prefill. Keep it one curl command and one tiny pseudocode snippet showing jittered schedule. Something like:
```bash
# prefill top prompts (one-off)
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/prefill \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \n  -d '{"tenant_id":"ACME", "templates":["reset_prompt","summary_prompt"], "concurrency":2}'
```
And pseudocode for jittered prefill cron: `every 5m +/- rand(0..45s)`
Maya Torres: Perfect. Also include guidance for streaming fallback: set client timeout to 12s, then fallback to streaming with `max_tokens` cap to protect costs. Example: "if batch call fails, open streaming channel and send smaller chunk".
Aisha Patel: Include operational knobs: cache TTL suggestions (start with 10m for ephemeral prompts, 24h for static templates), batch size guidance (2-8 depending on latency SLO), and a circuit-breaker threshold (5% 5xx over 10m -> throttle to low concurrency). Keep wording non-techy.
Samir Rao: For renewal/health signals, propose a simple color status we can show to customers: GREEN = prefill_hit_pct >= 75% AND stream_median_ms < 500ms; YELLOW = prefill_hit_pct 50–75% OR stream_median_ms 500–800ms; RED = prefill_hit_pct < 50% OR stream_median_ms > 800ms or sustained errors.
Maya Torres: Love the color status idea. We'll add an example email snippet CS can send: short subject, three bullet points about what we observed and recommended next steps (+ link to enablement doc).
Liam Chen: We should also capture quick feedback: a one-click thumbs up / thumbs down embedded in the doc and a single-line text box for what changed after applying the checklist. That feeds into the renewal playbook.
Aisha Patel: One more operational note: if customers are on shared-hosted, include the fallback path to request a temporary warm pool for a weekend ramp (contact ops@redwood.ai, include tenant_id, expected QPS, and ramp window).
DevBot: Deploy checklist doc draft available at https://confluence.redwood.ai/cs/activation/edge-prefill-playbook-draft (internal link). Please review before EOD.
Maya Torres: Next steps: Samir drafts the checklist + color status table, Liam adds sample curl + pseudocode, Aisha writes telemetry paragraph and simple metric names, I'll assemble the customer email + feedback widget. Can we aim to ship to CS enablement repo by tomorrow noon?
Samir Rao: On it — I'll ping when first draft is ready.
Liam Chen: I'll drop the snippets into a single MD file.
Aisha Patel: I'll mock the metric alarm thresholds we recommend so CS can paste them into the customer's monitoring.
Maya Torres: Thanks team — low word-count, high signal. If anyone sees edge cases (multi-tenant isolated customers, on-prem customers) call them out in the doc with a short note.
DevBot: Reminder: create a public-facing copy that strips internal escalation emails; use support@redwood.ai for outward-facing contact.
Samir Rao: Noted. Will add a short appendix: "If you're seeing sustained RED status, book a 30-min troubleshooting call here: https://cal.com/redwood-cs/30"
Maya Torres: Great — closing this thread. Will post the final customer-facing checklist link here when done. :rocket:
